channel.title: Pier & Point · Sophie Maxwell Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Sophie Maxwell Building (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Sophie Maxwell Building: Sources disagree on when construction of the Sophie Maxwell…
item.description: Sources disagree on when construction of the Sophie Maxwell Building began: SF YIMBY said it started at the October 12, 2023 groundbreaking, while the 2024 annual report dates the formal start to June 2024. The lender fact now shows both the Chronicle's and the Standard's accounts of the bank search. The developer line no longer calls Found Middle LP an affiliate of Associate Capital, since no source says so. Source: https://sfyimby.com/2023/10/construction-starts-for-housing-in-potrero-power-station.html ; https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/jpmorgan-housing-san-francisco-22367970.php ; https://sfstandard.com/2025/10/15/potrero-power-station-middle-income-housing/ ; https://swinerton.com/news-and-insights/project/the-sophie-maxwell-building/ ; https://www.potreroview.net/affordable-housing-to-be-built-at-site-of-retired-potrero-power-plant/ ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=4232020.

item.title: Correction · Sophie Maxwell Building: The Sophie Maxwell Building page now dates the topping out…
item.description: The Sophie Maxwell Building page now dates the topping out to November 21, 2024 (the developer's newsletter), not December. Where City documents differ by a day on when the design review and site permit applications were submitted, both dates are shown. The Port says construction was completed in August 2025, while the Department of Building Inspection closed the new-construction permit on August 28, 2026; both are recorded. Source: Planning Dept. Potrero Power Station Block 7B design review memo and 2021-2024 annual compliance reports (sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 202212229038; Port Commission calendar item 10A, 2025-11-14; Supervisor Shamann Walton press release, 2025-10-15 (sfbos.org).
item.source: Planning Dept. Potrero Power Station Block 7B design review memo and 2021-2024 annual compliance reports (sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 202212229038; Port Commission calendar item 10A, 2025-11-14; Supervisor Shamann Walton press release, 2025-10-15 (sfbos.org)

item.title: Correction · Sophie Maxwell Building: The record now says October 2025 was the grand opening and…
item.description: The record now says October 2025 was the grand opening and ribbon-cutting and that first residents moved in during November 2025 (Hoodline, citing the SF Chronicle; ABC7 gave Nov 1 only as the planned date); it previously showed October 2025 move-in and Nov 1, 2025 as a settled day. The Essential Housing Fund contribution is now shown as reported on Aug 3, 2026 as expected, with no later confirmation found. Also corrected: the Block 7B contracts figure is described as contracts and change orders (the report does not call them design contracts), 'Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District No. 1' is now just the EIFD the sources name, the Fifth Space rename no longer carries a year, two sources' headline and date were corrected, and a milestone now cites the 2023 annual report for the Oct 2023 site permit. Source: Hoodline, 2025-12-06 (https://hoodline.com/2025/12/s-f-s-new-sophie-maxwell-pads-throw-lifeline-to-city-s-squeezed-middle/); ABC7 San Francisco, 2025-10-20 (https://abc7news.com/post/new-sophie-maxwell-building-open-offering-affordable-essential-housing-middle-class-san-franciscans/18015271/); SF YIMBY, 2025-10-24 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/10/sophie-maxwell-affordable-housing-opens-in-potrero-power-station-san-francisco.html); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-08-03 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/jpmorgan-housing-san-francisco-22367970.php); California Barrel Company and Found Middle L.P., 2023 Annual Report, 2024-11-22 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).

item.title: Milestone · Sophie Maxwell Building: DBI's record for the new-construction permit… (Aug 28, 2026)
item.description: DBI's record for the new-construction permit (202212229038, 8 stories, 105 units) shows it completed on August 28, 2026, the same day as the project's related revision permits. This is a permit closing, not the date construction finished; the Port memo gives August 2025 for that (Aug 28, 2026). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9).
item.source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9)

item.title: Milestone · Sophie Maxwell Building: SF Chronicle reports the building is to be… (Aug 3, 2026)

Source: San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-08-03.
